scope: Every Rust source and Cargo manifest/lock recorded by the qualified build; new tracked/untracked crate Rust sources and manifests are rejected. Only the two explicit verifier methods differ in native runtime sources. Snapshot unit tests and public API test crate changes are listed separately.
limitations: This is a source delta proof, not a new accuracy or host-cost measurement. The rebuilt extension has a different binary hash. The new verifier performs I/O only when explicitly called; its cost is not covered by prior measurements. Python caller, documentation and example changes are outside this native proof.
